meta.source: safaria.vibing.world/home-301198 (#safaria-site stylesheet, saved 2026-11-02) + SAFARIA master brief

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground (--sf-bg). Every section sits on this unless it is a form shell.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Alternate section band and pricing tiles (--sf-green).

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text fields and selects (--sf-input; day = the Travel Studio field ground).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on every surface-* token (12.3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, service sub-lines on surface-000/100/200 (6.9:1 minimum).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Legal lines and footer meta on surface-footer (4.85:1 minimum). Never for anything a visitor must act on.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Champagne accent: eyebrow rules, icons, step numbers, active states, accent text on surface-000/200. Day value is darkened so it still reads as text (5.2:1).

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Top stop of the gold CTA gradient. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: gold-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the gold CTA gradient. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Label on gold-hi/gold-lo fills (7.2:1 on the darker stop).

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Primary emerald brand fill: day-theme primary buttons, emerald bands, logo S. Ivory on it is 8.9:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Royal navy: corporate travel band and aviation/tracker panels. Ivory on it 14.4:1, gold 8.2:1.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm ivory constant: text on emerald and navy in both themes, form shells on night pages.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections, list rows and card edges (--sf-line). Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: price cards, fields, toggles (3:1 or better on its ground).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus outline at 5px offset on every interactive element. Holds 5.9:1 or better on all surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid-field and sent states, always paired with a check icon and words.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Field errors, always paired with an icon and message text. Orange, not red, so it separates from success by lightness too.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Glass pills over imagery (motion toggle, scroll cue, hero chips).

families.sans: Inter, "Noto Sans Bengali", "Hind Siliguri", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: Wordmark text beside the logo in header and footer.

styles.name: bn-hero
styles.usage: h1 when lang=bn. clamp(44px, 5.2vw, 70px); 43px/1.45 on phones.

styles.name: bn-body
styles.sample: আপনার ভ্রমণের তথ্য দিন, আমাদের প্রতিনিধি যোগাযোগ করবেন।
styles.usage: Bengali body copy; never set Bengali at 1.65 leading.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Air tickets, visas, hotels and tours, handled by people who answer.
styles.usage: Hero and section intros, max 470px wide; 15px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us where you are going. A SAFARIA agent prepares a verified quotation.

styles.name: service-title
styles.usage: Service list rows and card titles; 16px on phones.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Visa decisions are made by the relevant authority.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above h2, followed by a 42px gold rule.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section inner padding, service layout gap.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tap target.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Price cards, trial bar, form shells.

duration.note: Motion tokens. Pair each with an easing below; everything collapses to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-short
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, colour and border transitions (matches existing .sf-button).

tokens.name: dur-long
tokens.usage: Hero entrance and cinematic image wipes.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a staggered list or headline lines.

tokens.name: dur-continuous
tokens.usage: One globe revolution; decorative loops only.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small confirmations: tick, chip select. Never on large surfaces.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Destination dialog and AI assistant panel.
